metadataRaw.title: Fix a High Hip With One Simple Exercise #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise to help fix a pelvic tilt (aka high hip or short leg). 

A high hip tends to come about from muscle weakness and tightness. This exercise will help lengthen and strengthen pelvic and hip muscles to get rid of a high hip for good.

It requires no equipment and can be done at home.

Let us know how it works for you!
